verdict.rationale: Quantization is a fair question for a local LLM runner, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions quantization formats, bit-widths (e.g. 2-bit to 8-bit), or memory-footprint reduction. The llama.cpp/MLX runtime mentions and Hugging Face downloads are adjacent and do not document integer quantization support.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reduce memory footprint using integer quantization ranging from very low-bit to 8-bit precision
